chapter_title_en: The Secret of Flesh and Blood Rebirth
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 382: The Secret of Flesh-and-Blood Rebirth Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen discovers the ancient technique for flesh-and-blood rebirth in the Death World, endures a painful activation of his dead bones, and learns of Keke's reappearance in the mortal world.
og_title: Xiao Chen Uncovers the Method to Regain His Human Body
og_description: In the Death World, Xiao Chen obtains a five-colored fire seed and unlocks the secret of rebirth, while news of Keke's suffering drives him forward.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's skeleton transformation leads to the discovery of the flesh-and-blood rebirth technique; Keke is spotted nearby, pursued by enemies.
